{{Quote|The ''slavers'' supply the ''meat'' for the low-end duels&mdash;and when one of us gets big, it's the Franchise that cashes in. Goethar Kleej is their investment&mdash;and their product. They own everything I am.|Goethar Kleej|<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" />}}
'''Goethar Kleej''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] who was kidnapped by [[The Crucible|Crucible]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] to compete in [[Swoopdueling/Legends|swoopdueling]] matches for the [[Franchise]] entertainment firm. Despite having his sensory [[cones]] severed by his abductors, Kleej performed well in training, and by [[3963 BBY]], he had won the [[Solo Aerials]] four times in succession. At the end of his fourth victory, he tried to tell the event's spectators about the slaving operations behind the Franchise, but a harmless pre-recorded speech was played over his words. The operator of the events, a [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] named [[Bardron]], assaulted Kleej for attempting to expose the Franchise, but he later made an offer of retirement to Kleej provided that the Gotal and his son, [[Aubin Kleej|Aubin]], won the forthcoming [[Tandem Open]] event. Aubin was hindered by his inability to filter electromagnetic signals received through his cones, so he would be unlikely to progress without help. As Kleej would not be in the same round as his son until the final round, he intimidated fellow competitor [[Zayne Carrick]] into protecting Aubin. [[Parent/Legends|Father]] and son both advanced to the final round, where Carrick, now wanting to help Kleej, set in action a plan for them to escape. Deliberately crashing out of the arena, the Gotals were then smuggled out of the [[Jervo's World|venue]] in a trash bin. Upon reaching the safety of the [[Pantolomin/Legends|planet below]], Kleej saw that [[Jarael|one]] of Carrick's companions had been a Crucible slaver and fled with his son.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I figured you'd pull some stunt sooner or later. You're a player, Goethar&mdash;and that means you're an ''idiot''. But I know you understand this&mdash;when duelists fight out of their class&hellip;''mistakes happen''.''"<br />"''Put me back in, Bardron! I'll fight the Tandem&mdash;beside him!''"<br />"''Brackets are set, champ. If we put you in the last qualifier, you wouldn't meet until the end. But let's make it interesting. We'll put you in the Open. If by some miracle you both win, you can retire for real&mdash;''both'' of you.|Bardron, making Kleej an offer for both he and [[Aubin Kleej|his son]] to retire|<ref name="KOTOR39:DA1" />}}
Goethar Kleej was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] who,<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" /> around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of a [[Mandalorian Wars|war]]<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" /> fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> was abducted<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" /> by [[The Crucible]]<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" /> [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] organization and was forced to train as a competitor for [[Swoopdueling/Legends|swoopdueling]] matches run by the [[Franchise]] entertainment firm. Early on during his stay in The Crucible's [[Dueling Pits|training pits]], Kleej's slaver,<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" /> [[Chantique]],<ref name="KOTOR46:D2">[[Knights of the Old Republic 46|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 46]]</ref> became angry with him and ordered his [[cones]] to be severed. The removal of the sensory organs, unique to Gotals, that picked up electromagnetic signals was a heinous act in Gotal culture. Kleej later had false cones implanted to disguise the fact but still had to rely on his other senses to live. While in the slave pits, Kleej had a son, [[Aubin Kleej|Aubin]], with [[Aubin Kleej's mother|another Gotal]]. Aubin's mother was able to help him filter out the electromagnetic signals he received, but she was later [[Death/Legends|killed]], leaving Aubin helpless.<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" />

[[File:GoetharThreatensZayne-KOTOR39.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kleej threatening Carrick to protect his son.]]
Kleej performed well in training and was put through to the top swoopdueling events, participating in the [[Solo Aerials]] at [[Jervo's World]]&mdash;a massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]] run by the Franchise over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]&mdash;and, as of [[3963 BBY]], he had won it four times consecutively.<ref name="KOTOR39:DA1" /> Kleej's popularity was such that he did advertisements and endorsements, had a toy line,<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" /> and was used as a mascot for the events.<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" /> Kleej won his fourth Solo Aerials by defeating one of the [[D'qell Sisters]] and, at the end of the match, attempted to inform the crowds of spectators about the hidden slaving practices that provided duelists for the Franchise. However, a pre-recorded speech was played over his pleas for help to the spectators in which he instead announced his retirement. In return for threatening to reveal the slavery behind the game, Kleej was physically beaten by two underlings of [[Bardron]]&mdash;the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] in charge of the actual games themselves&mdash;and was threatened with being sent back to the training pits. Kleej noted that, if sent back to the pits, he would at least be able to see his son, not having done so since the start of the season. Expecting the emotional attachment to Aubin, Bardron revealed that the Gotal's son had been put in the upcoming [[Tandem Open]] and that the other competitors had been told to avoid him. Bardron made Kleej the offer that if both he and Aubin won the Open, they would both be able to retire fully. However, the two Gotals would not be in the same round unless they both advanced to the finals. Meanwhile, former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] had entered the same Tandem Open round as Aubin and also managed to advance to the next round. Kleej approached the [[Human/Legends|Human]] after the round and ordered him to protect Aubin so that he would make it through to the finals, threatening Carrick with death if he failed to do so.<ref name="KOTOR39:DA1" />

In the semi-finals, Carrick successfully got himself and Aubin through to the next round, though the Gotal struggled throughout the match. Kleej had meanwhile returned to the sport in the same semi-final round and fought with another contender, "[[Demagol|Spikes]]," the "[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] miscreant." The two exchanged [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire before Kleej leaped at "Spikes" from his [[Swoop/Legends|bike]], proceeding to engage him in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. The pair then quickly turned and simultaneously shot a [[Unidentified Night-Soarer|Night-Soarer competitor]], leaving them as the last two standing and putting them through to the final round. After the match, when Kleej explained to Carrick how he was tied to the Franchise, and thus couldn't simply leave, Carrick offered to help expose the slaving practices. Meanwhile, on another part of the station, Bardron and [[Jervo Thalien]], a prime investor of the Franchise, plotted to remove Kleej permanently by fixing the match.<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" />

[[File:Tyluun_vs_Goethar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kleej escaping from the arena]]
In the final round, several of the safety mechanisms in place were disabled on Bardron's orders to put Aubin, Goethar, Carrick, and "Spikes" at a disadvantage. Shortly after the start, the brakes failed on Kleej's swoop bike and the accelerator jammed, forcing him to transfer Aubin, who had been riding with him, from his bike to Carrick's. When a [[Unidentified Mandallian Giant|Mandallian Giant competitor]] attacked Aubin and Carrick, Kleej leaped to protect his son and dispatched the fighter. Remounting his swoop, Kleej followed Carrick's plan and crashed his bike through a window in the side of the arena with Carrick and Aubin following suit. To distract the crowd, the event's [[Music/Legends|musician]] played his [[Data cube/Legends|data cube]], not knowing that [[Marn Hierogryph]]&mdash;one of Carrick's companions&mdash;had replaced its contents with parts of Kleej's original speech exposing the Franchise as well as part of the conversations between Bardron and Thalien<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" /> that Hierogryph had eavesdropped upon earlier.<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" /> Using the uproar that this generated in the crowd as cover, Carrick smuggled Kleej and his son to a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Pantalomin below in a large trash bin. Once on the planet, Carrick assured Kleej that he could take the Gotal to someone who would be able to act on Kleej's revelations about the Franchise, as well as help Aubin with his difficulties. One of Carrick's other companions, [[Jarael]], soon appeared, and Kleej recognized her [[Flames of the Crucible|facial tattoos]] signifying her as a slaver for The Crucible. Pushing her away and berating Carrick for associating himself with the former slaver, Kleej fled with his son.<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You fight like you are fighting ''for'' someone.|"Spikes," to Kleej|<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" />}}
After suffering poor treatment at the hands of The Crucible when in training, Goethar Kleej dedicated himself to swoopdueling in the hopes that it would be able to get his son out of the fighting. Kleej also held himself responsible for not being able to help his son Aubin deal with the myriad of electromagnetic signals he received.<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" /> When Aubin was put into the Tandem Open, Kleej strove to protect him by making death threats to Zayne Carrick<ref name="KOTOR39:DA1" /> and later dispatching a competitor who was attacking Aubin.<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" /> Despite the difficulties that he was faced with, Kleej remained optimistic with a saying from the training pits that "false hope was better than none." Kleej also had an extreme fear of the slavers who had trained him,<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" /> a fear that made him get himself and Aubin away from Jarael as soon as he recognized what she was.<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" />

==Skills and abilities==
[[File:Goethar_Kleej_swoop.png|thumb|right|250px|Geothar Kleej riding in his fourth Solo Aerials race]]
{{Quote|He's done it! He's done it! ''Goethar Kleej'' has just become the first warrior to win the ''Solo Aerials'' for the ''fourth consecutive time!''<s></s>|A commentator at the Solo Aerials|<ref name="KOTOR39:DA1" />}}
Goethar Kleej was an exceptional swoop rider<ref name="KOTOR41:DA3" /> and duelist, ably winning the Solo Aerials four times. Such was his success and popularity that swoop manufacturer [[Lhosan Industries]] awarded a [[Goethar Special|specially painted bike]] to the winner of Kleej's last Tandem Open.<ref name="KOTOR39:DA1" /> The Gotal also successfully managed to cope with the loss of his cones, relying on his other senses to compensate.<ref name="KOTOR40:DA2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Goethar Kleej's first and only appearance was in the [[2009]] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Dueling Ambitions|''Dueling Ambitions'']], penciled by [[Brian Ching]] and written by [[John Jackson Miller]]. When planning the story arc, Miller decided upon Kleej's species by first trying to find a suitable species that would fit Aubin's predicament of struggling with his sensory perception, finding that Gotals fitted his needs.<ref name="Faraway40">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor40.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #40''}}</ref>
